title: orchis mascula subsp. acutiflora
intro: Orchis mascula subsp. acutiflora, commonly known as the Red Hairy Orchid or the Red Male Orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is believed to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Orchis mascula subsp. acutiflora include diuretic, expectorant, and antispasmodic effects, which may help to relieve respiratory issues and promote urination. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
